name: omniagents-design-patterns
description: Strict-typed Python 3.13+ design pattern catalogue, split into three skills: software (in-service patterns — GoF, functional/ADTs, DDD, architectural, in-process concurrency, code anti-patterns), system (cross-service patterns — reliability, communication, distributed, data, scaling, cloud, distributed anti-patterns), and codebase-design (Ousterhout interface depth — deep vs shallow modules, information hiding, deletion test, design-it-twice).
